```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '70149-1'})
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
LIMIT 1
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[hp:HAS_PART]->(p:Part)
WHERE hp.is_spare = false
WITH inv, sum(hp.qty) AS direct_qty
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cs:CONTAINS_SET]->(ns:Set)
OPTIONAL MATCH (inv)-[cm:CONTAINS_MINIFIG]->(mf:Minifig)
WITH inv, direct_qty, collect({item: ns, qty: cs.qty, type: 'set'}) + collect({item: mf, qty: cm.qty, type: 'minifig'}) AS nested_items
UNWIND nested_items AS item
WITH inv, direct_qty, item
CALL {
  WITH item
  WITH item
  MATCH (item.item)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(nested_inv:Inventory)
  WITH item, nested_inv
  ORDER BY nested_inv.version DESC
  LIMIT 1
  OPTIONAL MATCH (nested_inv)-[hp2:HAS_PART]->(p2:Part)
  WHERE hp2.is_spare = false
  RETURN sum(hp2.qty) AS nested_part_qty
}
WITH inv, direct_qty, sum(item.qty * nested_part_qty) AS nested_total_qty
RETURN round(100.0 * nested_total_qty / (direct_qty + nested_total_qty), 2) AS percentage
```

```cypher
MATCH (s:Set {set_num: '80014-1'})
MATCH (s)-[:HAS_INVENTORY]->(inv:Inventory)
WITH s, inv
ORDER BY inv.version DESC
WITH s, head(collect(inv)) AS currentInv
MATCH p = (currentInv)-[:CONTAINS_SET|CONTAINS_MINIFIG*0..]->(i:Inventory)
WHERE all(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.qty > 0)
WITH p, reduce(acc = 1, r IN relationships(p) | acc * r.qty) AS multiplier
MATCH (i)-[:HAS_PART]->(part:Part {part_num: '43093'})
WHERE i.is_spare = false
RETURN sum(multiplier * i.qty) AS total
```

```cypher
MATCH (s:Set)-[:IN_THEME]->(t:Theme)
WHERE s.year = 2013
  AND (t.name = 'Books' OR (t)-[:SUBTHEME_OF*]->(:Theme {name: 'Books'}))
WITH s
MATCH (s)-[r:CONTAINS]->(item)
WHERE r.version = (s.own_max_version)
WITH s, item, r
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (item)-[:CONTAINS*0..]->(p:Part)
WHERE all(rel IN relationships(path) WHERE rel.is_spare = false)
WITH s, r, p, path
WHERE p IS NOT NULL
WITH s, r, p, reduce(qty = 1, rel IN relationships(path) | qty * rel.qty) AS path_qty
RETURN sum(r.qty * path_qty) AS total_parts
```

```cypher
MATCH (s:Set)-[:IN_THEME]->(t:Theme)
WHERE s.year = 2022
  AND (t.name = 'Books' OR EXISTS {
    MATCH (t)-[:SUBTHEME_OF*]->(parent:Theme)
    WHERE parent.name = 'Books'
  })
WITH s
MATCH (s)-[r:CONTAINS]->(item)
WHERE r.version = s.current_version
WITH s, r, item
OPTIONAL MATCH path = (item)-[:CONTAINS*0..]->(p:Part)
WHERE all(rel IN relationships(path) WHERE rel.is_spare = false)
WITH s, r, item, path, p
WHERE p IS NOT NULL
WITH s, r.qty AS topQty, reduce(acc = 1, rel IN relationships(path) | acc * rel.qty) AS pathQty
RETURN sum(topQty * pathQty) AS total_parts
```
